Definition: apparently a participle from an otherwise obsolete derivative of the base of G2330; a menial attendant (as if cherishing):--servant.
BiblicalUsage: therápōn is the word for a servant, an attendant. In Hebrews 3:5, as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken after.
TheologicalSignificance: Moses counted faithful as a servant in God's house shows me there is honour in serving without needing to own the house.
